hookups.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/myakka-river-state-park/experiences-amenities-0 ('The park features three campgrounds with 90 campsites, each equipped with 20/30/50 amp electrical service, water, a fire ring and picnic table. The sites in Palmetto Ridge also have sewer hook-ups.') + Reserve Florida unit details (Loop PR: 38 sites with sewer), read 2026-10-21 in a browser

values.note: 90 campsites in three campgrounds (Big Flats, Old Prairie, Palmetto Ridge). Reserve Florida lists 80 'RV or Tent' sites: Big Flats 21 (20-35 ft) plus 6 tent-only, Old Prairie 21 (20-35 ft), Palmetto Ridge 38 (40-45 ft, 10 pull-throughs). Hammock camping is allowed on sites 7, 8, 11, 15, 23, 27, 33 and 48.

sites.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/myakka-river-state-park/experiences-amenities-0 ('three campgrounds with 90 campsites'; hammock sites) + Reserve Florida search/grid and search/details for facilities 127, 130, 131 (VehicleLength, PullInTypeName), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/myakka-river-state-park/experiences-amenities-0 ('A dump station is located near Old Prairie Campground. Laundry facilities are available to all campers in Old Prairie and Palmetto Ridge campgrounds. All campsites are within 40 yards of restroom facilities with hot showers.'), read 2026-10-21

booking.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/myakka-river-state-park/experiences-amenities-0 ('Reservations can be made up to 11 months in advance. For reservations, visit the Florida State Parks reservations website or call 800-326-3521') + Reserve Florida search/place PlaceId 47 Restrictions (MinimumStay 1, MaximumStay 14), read 2026-10-21

note: Big Flats campground sits near the Upper Myakka Lake, the Myakka Outpost and Wi-Fi; Old Prairie and Palmetto Ridge are near the SR 72 entrance and the river, and only Palmetto Ridge has sewer. Drinking water has been unavailable park-wide since Oct. 28, 2025 - bring your own; bottled water is free at the ranger station (park page, read 2026-10-21). --Claude
